mapper.sql: SELECT s.survey_id, s.user_id, s.title, s.move_mode , DATE_FORMAT(s.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') created_at , DATE_FORMAT(s.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d') updated_at , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM survey_plan p WHERE p.survey_id = s.survey_id) item_cnt , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.plan_id) FROM survey_plan p JOIN survey_record r ON r.plan_id = p.plan_id WHERE p.survey_id = s.survey_id) done_cnt , IFNULL(s.sgg_cd, (SELECT b.sgg_cd FROM survey_plan p JOIN vulnerability_factor f ON f.factor_id = p.factor_id JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = f.bld_id WHERE p.survey_id = s.survey_id ORDER BY p.visit_order, p.plan_id LIMIT 1)) sgg_cd , (SELECT b.emd_nm FROM survey_plan p JOIN vulnerability_factor f ON f.factor_id = p.factor_id JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = f.bld_id WHERE p.survey_id = s.survey_id ORDER BY p.visit_order, p.plan_id LIMIT 1) emd_nm , (SELECT CONCAT(b.addr, IFNULL(CONCAT(' ', b.bld_nm), IFNULL(CONCAT(' ', b.use_nm), ''))) FROM survey_plan p JOIN vulnerability_factor f ON f.factor_id = p.factor_id JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = f.bld_id WHERE p.survey_id = s.survey_id ORDER BY p.visit_order, p.plan_id LIMIT 1) first_addr FROM survey_list s
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%')) x
x.item_cnt > 0 AND x.done_cnt >= x.item_cnt (x.item_cnt = 0 OR x.done_cnt < x.item_cnt) AND (x.sgg_cd = #{gu} OR x.sgg_cd IS NULL)
ORDER BY x.updated_at DESC, x.survey_id DESC
SELECT * FROM ( WHERE s.survey_id = #{surveyId} AND s.user_id = #{userId}) x WHERE (x.sgg_cd = #{gu} OR x.sgg_cd IS NULL)
SELECT DISTINCT b.sgg_cd FROM vulnerability_factor f JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = f.bld_id WHERE f.factor_id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO survey_list (user_id, sgg_cd, title, move_mode) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sggCd}, #{title}, IFNULL(#{moveMode}, 'WALK'))
mapper.update: UPDATE survey_list SET move_mode = #{moveMode} WHERE survey_id = #{surveyId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.plan_id, p.survey_id, p.factor_id, f.bld_id, p.visit_order, DATE_FORMAT(p.plan_date, '%Y-%m-%d') plan_date , b.addr, b.bld_nm, b.use_nm, b.emd_nm, b.sgg_cd, b.useapr_day, b.grnd_flr, b.ugrnd_flr, b.lat, b.lng , b.welf_nm, b.welf_dist, b.hosp_nm, b.hosp_dist , CAST(f.vulnerability_score AS SIGNED) score , CONCAT_WS(' · ', IF(b.ugrnd_res = 1, '지하층', NULL), IF(b.sp_type = '고시원', '고시원', NULL), IF(b.viol_yn = '1', '위반건축물', NULL) , IF(b.flood_cnt >= 1, '침수', NULL), IF(b.elev_m <= 15, '저지대', NULL)) factor_text , (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(r.created_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') FROM survey_record r WHERE r.plan_id = p.plan_id) checked_at , (SELECT v.result FROM survey_record r JOIN visit_history v ON v.visit_id = r.visit_id WHERE r.plan_id = p.plan_id ORDER BY r.record_id DESC LIMIT 1) check_result , (SELECT r.content FROM survey_record r WHERE r.plan_id = p.plan_id ORDER BY r.record_id DESC LIMIT 1) check_content FROM survey_plan p JOIN vulnerability_factor f ON f.factor_id = p.factor_id JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = f.bld_id WHERE p.survey_id = #{surveyId} ORDER BY p.visit_order IS NULL, p.visit_order, p.plan_id
mapper.update: UPDATE survey_plan SET visit_order = NULL WHERE survey_id = #{surveyId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM survey_plan p JOIN survey_record r ON r.plan_id = p.plan_id WHERE p.survey_id = #{surveyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO survey_plan (survey_id, factor_id, visit_order) VALUES (#{surveyId}, #{factorId}, #{visitOrder}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE visit_order = VALUES(visit_order)
INSERT INTO visit_history (user_id, bld_id, visited_at, result) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bldId}, IFNULL(#{visitedAt}, NOW()), #{result})
INSERT INTO survey_record (plan_id, visit_id, content, factor_check, score_adj) VALUES (#{planId}, #{visitId}, #{content}, #{factorCheck}, #{scoreAdj})
mapper.select: SELECT f.factor_id, f.vulnerability_id, l.title, f.bld_id, b.sgg_cd, b.emd_nm, b.addr, b.bld_nm, b.use_nm, b.lat, b.lng , CAST(f.vulnerability_score AS SIGNED) score , IFNULL(rs.vuln_hh_cnt, 0) vuln_hh_cnt, IFNULL(rs.priority_sum, 0) priority_sum , CONCAT_WS(' · ', IF(b.ugrnd_res = 1, '지하층', NULL), IF(b.sp_type = '고시원', '고시원', NULL), IF(b.viol_yn = '1', '위반건축물', NULL)) factor_text , DATE_FORMAT(f.evaluated_at, '%Y-%m-%d') saved_at , status , (SELECT sp.survey_id FROM survey_plan sp WHERE sp.factor_id = f.factor_id ORDER BY sp.plan_id LIMIT 1) survey_id , (SELECT sl.title FROM survey_plan sp JOIN survey_list sl ON sl.survey_id = sp.survey_id WHERE sp.factor_id = f.factor_id ORDER BY sp.plan_id LIMIT 1) survey_title FROM vulnerability_factor f JOIN vulnerability_list l ON l.vulnerability_id = f.vulnerability_id JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = f.bld_id LEFT JOIN bld_resident_stat rs ON rs.bld_id = b.bld_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.is_active = 1 AND b.sgg_cd = #{gu} ORDER BY f.vulnerability_score DESC, vuln_hh_cnt DESC, priority_sum DESC, f.bld_id
